data.title: Lantern Street
data.solution:
import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    h = list(map(int, data[1:1 + n]))
    stack = []          # strictly decreasing heights
    pairs = 0
    for x in h:
        while stack and stack[-1] < x:
            pairs += 1  # the lower roof on the stack sees x
            stack.pop()
        if stack:
            pairs += 1  # the roof on top of the stack sees x
            if stack[-1] == x:
                stack.pop()  # an equal roof hides everything behind it
        stack.append(x)
    print(pairs)

main()
data.statement:
Every night the lamplighter of Lantern Street wonders how many pairs of roofs can wave at each other.

The street is a single row of N buildings. Two roofs see each other when every building standing between them is strictly lower than both of them. Two neighbouring roofs always see each other.

Count the pairs of roofs that see each other.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

Every night the lamplighter of Lantern Street wonders how many pairs of roofs can wave at each other.

The street is a single row of N buildings. Two roofs see each other when every building standing between them is strictly lower than both of them. Two neighbouring roofs always see each other.

Count the pairs of roofs that see each other.
Input
Line 1: an integer N, the number of buildings.
Line 2: N space-separated integers H, the heights of the buildings from left to right.
Output
One integer: the number of pairs of roofs that see each other.
Constraints
2 ≤ N ≤ 50000
1 ≤ H ≤ 1000000
Example
Input
6
3 1 2 5 5 2
Output
7
